HMPV Virus is not new to India. There is no need to panic. It is a Virus which affects little kids below 5 years, elderly, causing common cold type symptoms. The patient recovers within 2 to 5 days.

HMPV infestation is common in winter sea

Only immunocompromised patients, the weak, debilitated and premature infants are at high risk.
Hospitalisation is required in a few cases.

Every year we have cases of HMPV Virus. They are just treated as common viral infestation of LRT. #HMPvirus

nodes.text: Cover yourself in winter, maintain hygiene, clean your hands and avoid overcrowded places if accompanied by kids. #HMPvirus
